source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of privacy and security threats (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Privacy aur security ke khatre afraad aur idaron dono ko mutasir karte aur zaati maloomat, maali data aur majmooi online hifazat ko nuqsan pohancha sakte hain. Inhein samajhna hassas maloomat bachane ka pehla qadam hai.

blocks.prompt: Security ke khatre kaunsi teen qism ki maloomat ko khatre mein dal sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Zaati maloomat, maali data aur majmooi online hifazat (accounts aur aalaat).

items: Privacy aur security ke khatre zaati aur maali data ko khatre mein dalte hain; inhein jaanna hifazat mein madad deta hai.
